title: New Developer: Richard Fuchs
html:
We’re happy to announce a new developer for the project: Richard Fuchs.

Richard has been working at Sipwise for over 4 years now and has already contributed many new features and bug fixes for our kamailio packages. Among those are the period matching in tmrec module, r-uri matching in lcr module and some IPv6 patches.

Welcome to the development team, Richard!
